title_sq: Apartament 1+1 i mobiluar tek Golden Park!
description_sq:
Apartament ne shitje, 1+1 i mobiluar tek "Tirana Golden Park"!
- "Tirana Golden Park", nje prej rezidencave me bashkohore ne kryeqytet, prane rruges se Kavajes, me te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode,
- Tipologjia 1+1, siperfaqe totale prej 68m2 (59m2 sip. neto), te organizuar ne sallonin e ndenjes, ambientin e gatimit/ngrenies, nje tualet, nje ballkon llozhe dhe korridori qe ben hyrjen ne apartament,
description_en: Apartment for sale, 1+1 furnished in "Tirana Golden Park"! - "Tirana Golden Park", one of the most contemporary residences in the capital, near Kavaje street, with all the facilities for a comfortable life, - 1+1 typology, total area of ​​68m2 (59m2 net surface area), organized in the living room, the cooking/dining area, a toilet, a loggia balcony and the corridor that makes the entrance to the apartment,
